notes: Prototype-only .tog is the demo data-source control and .top .as is the four-identity demo row. The application does not add either control. The four-identity row and its 8px gap make the prototype .top 89px high while the real single-perspective shell header is 49px; only __h is skipped on the topbar pair for that 40px prototype-only row. All topbar paint, padding, position, width and breadcrumb-row geometry remain compared.

The content wrapper's __h is skipped because the prototype and canonical full demo have different activity records and therefore different table heights. Its width, padding and the page header's anchor-relative geometry are compared.

The scope label has different data wording (prototype 示例组织; application 全部授权范围), so breadcrumb x positions are not selected. Icon/text y positions, sizes, typography and paint are compared without a skip.

The application uses the owner-supplied dual-theme AWR image in place of the prototype's SVG glyph. The pair selects the visible light/dark image and compares its box; the artwork itself remains the approved product asset.
There is no drawer, drawer mask or menu button in either the prototype or application. Those clauses were retired by the supervisor on 2026-11-20; no pairs are added for them.
